hmda.caveat: HMDA is a mortgage-application filing extract for properties located in Washington. It is not a Washington DFI license roster, not a quality ranking, and the denial rate does not prove discrimination. An HMDA reporter is not a Washington-licensed company. A Washington office or HQ on an HMDA reporter is geography, not licensing.

dfi_enforcement.caveat: A DFI order is not a CFPB complaint and is not a quality ranking. NOTICE is not a final order. Statement of Charges is not a final finding. Exact NMLS is required for adverse profile attachment. Name-only rows stay at event grain. This bounded HTML table is recent Consumer Services actions, not a complete historical bulk file. The 2025 year-end aggregate of 91 enforcement actions issued is a dated DFI statistic, not this table's row count.

dfi_aggregates.source: DFI Division of Consumer Services Stats at a Glance
dfi_aggregates.label: DFI year-end reported entities
dfi_aggregates.caveat: Point-in-time DFI year-end reported entities as of December 31, 2025. Not the current live Washington licensed-lender roster. Loan originators are people and are not a company count and are not a public person directory. Money transmitters and payday lenders are adjacent DFI classes, not added into a mortgage-company total.
dfi_aggregates.spring_2026_note: May 2026 DFI newsletter licensing numbers are a later dated aggregate, still not a live roster. Main-office vs branch rows are source-native and are not summed into one company denominator.

programs.application_path: WSHFC / Here to Home do not replace a mortgage underwriting decision. Buyers apply through a Commission-trained participating lender. Program participation is not a DFI license and is not a TrustHub endorsement. City or county local DPA is not inventoried on this state page.

items.name: Home Advantage / Home Advantage DPA
items.assistance: Commission first mortgage with down-payment assistance options described on official Here to Home pages
items.maximum: Official Here to Home DPA page: Home Advantage DPA offers 3%, 4%, or 5% of the first-mortgage loan amount at 0% interest. Confirm current options with a participating lender.
items.eligibility: Official page: first-time homeownership is not required for Home Advantage DPA. Owner-occupied principal residence. Household income must not exceed the official statewide cap published on the page. Homebuyer education is part of the Commission path.
items.income_purchase_limits: Official DPA page lists a statewide household-income cap; confirm the current dollar figure on heretohome.org. Not restated here as a guaranteed underwriting limit.
items.status: Documented on official WSHFC / Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: Home Advantage Needs-Based DPA
items.assistance: Needs-based down-payment assistance paired with the Home Advantage first mortgage, as described on the official DPA page
items.maximum: Official DPA page: up to $10,000 at 1% simple interest. Confirm current terms with a participating lender.
items.eligibility: Lower household-income path than standard Home Advantage DPA, with county-group income figures on the official page. Eligibility is not approval.
items.income_purchase_limits: Official page publishes separate King/Snohomish vs other-county income figures. Confirm current tables on heretohome.org.
items.status: Documented on official Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: House Key Opportunity
items.assistance: Below-market first mortgage with House Key Opportunity DPA for eligible first-time buyers
items.maximum: Official DPA page: House Key Opportunity DPA of up to $15,000 at 1% simple interest. Acquisition-cost and income limits apply.
items.eligibility: Aimed at first-time buyers (or Target Area exceptions as published). Two income tests and acquisition-cost limits are described on official job aids. Confirm current county tables.
items.income_purchase_limits: County-group income and acquisition-cost limits are published by WSHFC and change. Confirm on official materials; not copied here as a guarantee.
items.status: Documented on official Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: Covenant Homeownership Program
items.assistance: Down-payment and closing-cost assistance loan described on official Covenant pages
items.maximum: Official program materials describe a 0% interest second loan; confirm current maximum and any forgiveness path on HeretoHome.org/Covenant.
items.eligibility: Specialized statutory eligibility tied to the Covenant Homeownership Act study. First-time homebuyer rules and income limits apply as published. Not a general statewide DPA substitute.
items.income_purchase_limits: County income limits are published on the official Covenant page. Confirm current figures.
items.status: Documented on official Here to Home / Covenant pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: WSHFC Veterans down-payment assistance
items.assistance: Veterans-specific down-payment assistance listed on the official Here to Home DPA page
items.maximum: Confirm current amount and pairing rules on the official Veterans program page. Not restated here as a guaranteed dollar award.
items.eligibility: Veteran / military eligibility as published by WSHFC. Program availability is not borrower approval.
items.income_purchase_limits: Confirm official income/purchase rules on the Veterans page.
items.status: Documented on official Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: HomeChoice
items.assistance: Specialized HomeChoice assistance listed on official Here to Home pages
items.maximum: Confirm current terms on the official HomeChoice page.
items.eligibility: Specialized eligibility as published by WSHFC. Not a general first-time-buyer guarantee.
items.status: Documented on official Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

items.name: WSHFC homebuyer education
items.assistance: Required or recommended homebuyer education for Commission assistance programs
items.eligibility: Education completion is a program condition on official pages, not a loan approval.
items.status: Documented on official WSHFC / Here to Home pages retrieved this snapshot.

programs.caveat: Program terms change. Eligibility is not guaranteed approval. Headline amounts are official-page formulas, not a promise of funds. Seattle / King / other local programs are out of scope.

ckan.query: DFI mortgage broker consumer loan license roster

live_roster.caveat: Missing live roster is unknown, not zero. Search-only is not zero. Do not display a fake current license count. DFI year-end reported entities are a dated snapshot, not this live denominator. NMLS Consumer Access and the DFI licensee database were not scraped.

cfpb.caveat: Complaint is not a violation. Raw complaint count is not a quality ranking and is not exposure-normalized. No company complaint rate is published without an exposure denominator.
cfpb.canonical_company_snapshot: National CFPB company snapshot exists separately; this overlay is statewide Washington geography and is not a company ranking. No new fuzzy adverse matching.

servicing.dfi_exams_note: DFI year-end stats include mortgage-servicing exam counts; that is not a loan-level statewide servicing file.
servicing.caveat: No easy statewide servicing performance report was acquired. Consumer Loan companies may service mortgages; that class is not a live servicer roster.

foreclosure.note: No county recorder, deed, or trustee-sale crawl was performed. Missing statewide foreclosure structure is unknown, not zero. A consumer foreclosure-help page is not a structured statewide dataset.

depository.caveat: A Washington-headquartered FDIC-insured bank is a depository overlay, not a DFI mortgage-broker license. HMDA reporters include depositories and nonbanks. Do not call every HMDA reporter a DFI-licensed lender. NCUA credit-union overlay is not restated as a DFI class here.

public_contacts.policy: Official/public business sources only. No internet enrichment. No person contact information.
public_contacts.dfi_orders_contact_note: DFI enforcement HTML table has no phone, email, website, or address fields.
public_contacts.caveat: Zero contact fields from search-only license pages is a coverage gap, not a finding that Washington lenders have no phones.

regulator_matrix.what: Institution that filed HMDA loan/application records for Washington property location
regulator_matrix.proves: Reported application/origination activity in this vintage
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: Washington DFI license, current NMLS authority, or WSHFC program participation

regulator_matrix.what: Nationwide Multistate Licensing System identifier when source-native
regulator_matrix.regulator: NMLS (system of record display; not a Washington regulator)
regulator_matrix.proves: A stable identifier when printed by the source
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: Current Washington authority by itself, or whether the ID is an institution, branch, or person

regulator_matrix.what: Company licensed under the Mortgage Broker Practices Act
regulator_matrix.regulator: Washington DFI Division of Consumer Services
regulator_matrix.proves: DFI mortgage-broker class as of a stated evidence clock when a live record is verified in NMLS Consumer Access
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: HMDA reporter status, consumer-loan authority, or MLO person credential

regulator_matrix.what: Company licensed under the Consumer Loan Act; may originate or service mortgage and non-mortgage consumer loans
regulator_matrix.regulator: Washington DFI Division of Consumer Services
regulator_matrix.proves: DFI consumer-loan class as of a stated evidence clock when verified in NMLS Consumer Access
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: That the company is only a mortgage lender, or a live company census

regulator_matrix.what: Individual originator licensed through NMLS and sponsored as applicable
regulator_matrix.proves: Individual originator credential path when source-native
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: A company license. This site does not publish an MLO person directory

regulator_matrix.what: DFI-licensed escrow agent; verification may use the DFI Licensee Database rather than NMLS
regulator_matrix.proves: Escrow-agent class when a live DFI record is verified

regulator_matrix.what: Bank, savings bank, or credit union operating under a prudential charter
regulator_matrix.regulator: FDIC / NCUA / DFI Division of Banks or Credit Unions as applicable
regulator_matrix.proves: Charter identity when source-native (FDIC CERT, NCUA, RSSD)

regulator_matrix.what: Servicing of residential mortgage loans; often under the Consumer Loan Act when nonbank
regulator_matrix.regulator: Washington DFI Division of Consumer Services when licensed as a consumer-loan company
regulator_matrix.proves: Servicing activity only when a source-native license/order says so
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: A complete current servicer roster. No loan-level statewide servicing file was acquired

regulator_matrix.what: DFI money-transmitter class listed on year-end stats; adjacent, not a mortgage-company substitute
regulator_matrix.proves: Year-end reported money-transmitter count when cited as such
regulator_matrix.does_not_prove: Mortgage-broker authority. Not added into a lender total
